'''Baratatta''' was an [[Evocii]] village on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and the location of much resistance against [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] rule during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Huttsbane]] was a prominent member of the village. It also had a [[Baratatta Spirit-Leader|Spirit-Leader]], whose wisdom was respected even by Huttsbane.<ref name="BigChief">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Big Chief|Hutta}}</ref>
